notes.title: LOG : 3 weeks since the release
notes.content:
It’s been 3 weeks since Recompile release. After more than 2 years of development, we are pleased to see that the atmosphere, the graphics and the story of the game please you so much.

Thanks to you reviews on Steam and our social networks, we were able to make the necessary changes improving your gaming experience on Recompile. However, we are still looking for new reviews to perfect our game, in order to erase the negative point impacting your gameplay and your in-game experience. And equally identify the game aspects you enjoyed in purpose to improve the development of our following games.

notes.title: Patch notes for Aug 26th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34635094/be480e2214f03f4f790a6268db83b5f5a41fcec6.jpg[/img]
We've just updated the game with an incremental patch. Based on community feedback, we've fixed/added the following :-

- Adjusted maximum upwards aiming angle, you're now able to aim significantly higher than before
- Added a new Audio tab to the options menu, allowing adjustment of music and SFX volume
- Tweaked lighting and colors on the Quantum Cores and Batteries in the OKT areas, making them easier to see if they've been activated or not.

These are relatively minor/quick fixes, but please be assured we are also tackling bigger issues and features for future patches. Thank you for supporting the game!

notes.title: Recompile Release : 19 august
notes.content:
[h1]Immerse yourself in the cybernetic world of Recompile this 19th August 2021.
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=R2RibvIAFSo;full][/previewyoutube]

You are The Program, a semi-sapient computer virus created by the enigmatic Janus, on a mission to infiltrate and repair the Mainframe. A 3D virtual world living inside a decades long abandoned computer system, the Mainframe is a hostile environment to all external code.

The task will not be an easy one, for deep within the hidden subroutines exist an entity known only as the Hypervisor, an artificial intelligence turned corrupt after mysterious events.
Put the pieces together, solve the mystery of the Mainframe, and the discover the events that lead to humanity's greatest accomplishment.

Fight, hack and explore. Use every tool to perform your mission, your programming depends on it!

[h2]OTHER NEWS[/h2]

We've updated our key artwork and logo! 

Which one do you prefer?

notes.title: Recompile will be featured in the Ukie Game Showcase!
notes.content:
Ukie will host an event called the Ukie Game Showcase on June 3rd and 4th, and we’re glad to announce that Recompile will be a part of it! Join us on Sunday, the 4th of June, between 10am to 2pm, if you don’t want to miss any news about our indie gem.

[url=https://ukie.org.uk/news/2020/05/navigating-now-preparing-new-normal-ukie-game-showcase]See more info about the Ukie Game Showcase and Ukie’s Navigating the Now event here
[/url]

For Recompile, this will mainly be an opportunity to display the current state of the game to the press and tell you a bit more about our exciting plans for the future. Our 3D Metroidvania is more advanced and more beautiful than it ever was, and we can’t wait to share it with you guys!

The team from Phigames will tell you a bit more about the development of the game, directly in front of the cameras for a live interview. Tune into the event to meet the devs and hear their vision for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34635094/7edbb7721b0c3c590ffc3cf931cb1e2ef149806b.gif[/img]

[i]Recompile is a 3D Metroidvania set in a unique, virtual world called the Mainframe. Witness the birth of sentient AI and influence the future of technology through Recompile’s novative branching narrative! This game is a hybrid compilation of intense combat, tight platforming and environmental hacking, all of which contribute to the unique feeling of choosing your world’s fate.
[/i]

notes.title: You have a few days to try Recompile's demo! (read if you plan to try the demo)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34635094/ce0d3752fc91327262c002b3f3cccab8ec2b9881.jpg[/img]

Hello everybody!

We’re incredibly excited to be part of the [b]Steam Game Festival Spring Edition[/b] with a demo for Recompile! The team is still very busy developing the game despite the Corona Virus situation (but safely from home) but we had the opportunity to give you a little taste of Recompile. We hope you enjoy this early sandbox-y demo of the game that we showcased at a few events last year. To try it, you just need to click on the green demo button on our Steam page below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/986310/Recompile/

Please add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b], it really helps us a lot! Especially in these troubled times as quite a few promotional opportunities get (rightfully) canceled. 

Before we let you explore the Mainframe, please take a second to read some [b]important information[/b] below:

• The demo we just released is [b]NOT[/b] representative of the [b]final game[/b]. Neither visually as the game has been ported to HDRP and now looks so much better, but also mechanically: for example, the rate to which to you get power ups is altered for the fun factor.

• The final game is much more than a sandbox: it’s a metroidvania-inspired game with a narrative, branching paths, NPCs, different endings, environments, enemy types, lots more skills to unlock etc…

• A tip: shooting is not the only solution… ;)

https://youtu.be/zvLuHKEr-VE
Have fun!
